_comment: Roads this deployment monitors, and where to query a traffic provider for each.
Why this file exists: no traffic vendor knows what a 'road_segment_id' is in
this project. They know coordinates. So the mapping from a provider query to
the Stage 3 ML feature 'road_segment_id' has to live in configuration, and it
has to be editable without touching code or retraining the model.
Every segment below is one of the six categories the model was trained on
(SEG-01..SEG-06). A segment outside that set is rejected on load, because the
model would score it under a label it never learned.
road_name is display metadata only. The vendor response has no road name, so
the name here is what gets stored. free_flow_speed_kph_max is a sanity bound,
not a claim about the road: a reading above it indicates the point fell on an
unintended segment and is discarded rather than stored as a wild value.
